source: NASA GEDI Release 3 (V003) L2A/L2B/L4A footprints via the gediDB public TileDB database (GFZ Potsdam)
heights: elev_lowestmode (ground) in metres, NAVD88 orthometric (GEOID18) converted from the WGS84 ellipsoid; rh98/rh100 = canopy/top-of-object height above ground; cover = canopy cover fraction 0-1; pai = plant area index; agbd = aboveground biomass density
filters: l2a_quality_flag_rel3==1 and degrade_flag==0; cover/pai only where l2b_quality_flag_rel3==1; agbd only where l4a_quality_flag_rel3==1
licence: CC0 (NASA-led mission data; no restrictions on use, citation requested)
